changedFields.sourceEnglish: The three ethics as three linked circles of equal size: a hand holding soil for Earth Care, two people for People Care, and a basket passing between hands for Fair Share.
changedFields.targetText: Mahanyelo lawa manharhu ma kombisiwa hi swirhendzevutana swinharhu leswi hlanganisiweke, leswi ringanaka hi vukulu: voko leri khomeke misava ra Ku Hlayisa Misava; vanhu vambirhi va Ku Hlayisa Vanhu; na baskiti leri hundziseriwaka hi mavoko ra Ku Avelana hi Ku Ringana.

changedFields.sourceEnglish: Twelve design principles arranged as segments around a central seedling, each shown as a simple picture — an eye for observing, a droplet for catching water, a sun for energy, a loop for returning waste.
changedFields.targetText: Misinya ya milawu ya dizayini ya khume-mbirhi yi vekiwile hi swiphemu leswi rhendzeleke ximilana lexi nga exikarhini. Xiphemu xin’wana ni xin’wana xi kombisiwa hi xifaniso xo olova — tihlo ra ku xiyisisa, thonsi ra ku khoma mati, dyambu ra eneji, na xirhendzevutana lexi kombisaka ku vuyisa thyaka.

changedFields.sourceEnglish: Illustrated example farm: numbered markers 0 to 5 follow a winding footpath from the house and near garden, past chickens and a field, toward trees and a wilder riverside area. The markers are examples, not fixed boundaries or distances.
changedFields.targetText: Xikombiso xa purasi lexi kombisiweke hi swifaniso: tinomboro ta 0 ku ya eka 5 ti landzelela ndlela yo famba hi milenge leyi jikajikaka ku suka endlwini ni le xirhapeni xa le kusuhi, ti hundza tihuku ni nsimu, ti ya eka mirhi ni a wilder riverside area. Tinomboro leti i swikombiso ntsena; a hi mindzilakano leyi tiyisiweke kumbe mipfhuka leyi tiyisiweke.

changedFields.sourceEnglish: People Care: your family's needs come before market production
changedFields.targetText: People Care: swilaveko swa ndyangu wa wena swi rhanga market production

changedFields.sourceEnglish: A farmer sells all his surplus maize but keeps nothing for composting or seed saving. Which ethic is he most failing?
changedFields.targetText: Murimi u xavisa all his surplus maize kambe keeps nothing for composting or seed saving. Hi yihi ethic leyi a tsandzekaka ku yi landzelela ngopfu?
